title: A Salt for the Wolf
premise: In the valley of Hollowmere, where an ancient covenant suppresses all magic, Sable Zhou survives by stealing memories and selling them to the memory-broker Maren, never suspecting that his own stolen childhood holds the key to the covenant's origin. When the crown's witch-hunters breach the valley—proof the covenant is failing—Sable flees with a ragged found family: Maren, a disgraced huntress named Ilsa, and a child whose memories he accidentally absorbed. To end the hunt and the dying land's long winter, Sable must journey to the Wolf Court beyond the mountains and reforge the broken covenant by returning what was taken—including his own name and first memories. He succeeds at devastating cost: magic returns to the world balanced by sacrifice, the family scatters but endures, and Sable, half-remembering himself, chooses to begin again among the people who stayed.
about_author: Rosalind Whitlock is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing oral histories in remote mountain communities before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about bargains, borders, and the people who live in the gaps between them.

chapters.title: The Taste of Borrowed Light
chapters.summary: Sable steals the wedding memories of a wealthy merchant, showing his gift and his code: he takes only what can be spared. His mentor Maren warns him that buyers are asking stranger questions lately. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: uneasy comfort—the thief loves his small, hidden life without trusting it will last.

chapters.title: What the Valley Forgets
chapters.summary: Hunters arrive bearing royal writ, testing the valley's edge where magic supposedly cannot follow—and their charms work. Sable witnesses a neighbor with a minor gift dragged away. He discovers a hollow space in his own memory shaped like a door. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: dread; invisibility was always someone else's mercy, not a guarantee.

chapters.title: The Girl with Winter in Her Hair
chapters.summary: Fleeing a raid, Sable collides with Wren, a feral child whose memories flood into him unbidden—he sees her past: a burned village, a wolf-shaped shadow. Maren insists they keep her. Huntress Ilsa, sent to capture them, defects instead. POV: alternating Sable/Ilsa. Emotional beat: reluctant kinship forming under threat.

chapters.title: Ledger of Small Betrayals
chapters.summary: The fugitives shelter in Maren's cellar archive of stolen memories. Sable learns Maren has been selling valley memories to the crown for years—her betrayal funded their survival. Ilsa reveals the hunt's true purpose: harvesting gifted blood to feed a failing covenant. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: fury curdling into understanding; survival is never clean.

chapters.title: The Road Beyond the Charmline
chapters.summary: They slip past the valley's boundary at night, crossing into a landscape gripped by premature winter. Wren's presence quiets the cold—a sign she is bound to the covenant. Hunters track them; Ilsa buys time with violence she swore off. POV: Ilsa. Emotional beat: grief for the soldier she was, resolve for the protector she chooses to be.

chapters.title: Salt on the Threshold
chapters.summary: At a shrine on the mountain pass, a blind keeper reads Sable's hollow memory and tells him the truth: the first covenant was sealed with a stolen name—his ancestor's—and the crown has hunted his line since to keep it buried. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: vertigo of identity; the thief learns he is himself the theft.

chapters.title: Court of Teeth and Snow
chapters.summary: Captured by hunters, the group is brought before Lord Aldery, who reveals the winter is the old covenant collapsing—and he intends to seal a new one using Wren as the sacrifice. Sable bargains for their lives with the merchant memories, buying one night's freedom. POV: alternating Sable/Wren. Emotional beat: terror and tenderness; Wren forgives him for holding her memories.

chapters.title: The Long Falling
chapters.summary: The night escape goes wrong: Maren stays behind to hold the gate and is taken. In the storm, Sable finally opens his own hollow memory and recovers his stolen childhood—his mother's voice, the original sealing, the wolf who witnessed it. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: mourning and clarity; he knows now what reforging the covenant demands.

chapters.title: A Salt for the Wolf
chapters.summary: At the Wolf Court's ruined hearth, Sable offers the covenant its original price: his name and first memories, returned willingly rather than stolen. Wren adds her freely given bond, unbalancing Aldery's coercive rite. The wolf-shadow accepts; the false covenant shatters; Aldery's power fails as true magic floods back, gentle and bounded. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: sacrificial climax—giving up the self to save the selves he loves.

chapters.title: Beginning Again, Half-Remembered
chapters.summary: Spring thaws the valley. Sable, missing his earliest years but free of the hunt, returns with Wren and Ilsa; Maren survived, changed, and greets them at the charmline. Magic is no longer exiled but shared, and the community must learn its terms together. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution—found family intact, identity rebuilt from choice rather than inheritance.
